BETA Close X Sage Group PLC announced on May 27, 2026, that it purchased 2,102,978 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases were made from J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. The highest price paid per share was 878.6000 pence, the lowest was 845.0000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price was 857.6103 pence. Sage intends to cancel all repurchased shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 27 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
